The '''Imperial paratrooper force''' was a unit of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="LAU:TCS" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]]<ref name="TEGtD" /> was a highly decorated member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] paratrooper force.<ref name="LAU:TCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In Dark Forces we meet Admiral Mohc, a highly decorated member of the Imperial paratrooper force.|"The Creation Story" mentions the Imperial paratrooper force|<ref name="LAU:TCS" />}}
The Imperial paratrooper force was first mentioned in "[[LucasArts Update]]: The Creation Story," a [[1994]] article written by [[Sue Seserman]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 23|''Star Wars Insider'' 23]] that previewed the then-upcoming ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', a [[Wikipedia:First-person shooter|first-person shooter]] developed and published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="LAU:TCS" /> and released in [[1995]].<ref name="SW:DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>
